title: Simplify password update check
bug: The password can be changed without sending the old password.

findings.label: regression
findings.why: The new condition requires 'old_password' to be present and verified, so a request with 'password' but no 'old_password' now passes the check and returns 200 instead of the previous 400.

doppel_guided.summary: The PR unintentionally allows password changes without providing the old password, turning a 400 error into a successful 200 response.
